purpose: Rerun every preserved game trail and every current estate frontier until the first typed overlap, a bounded non-overlap on the declared surface, or an explicit unresolved boundary is reached.

overlap_classes.typed_object_overlap: The preserved trail names an exact typed object, program, vehicle, instrument, person role, or source domain that is explicitly within another estate's declared corpus. This is a routing result, not a relationship finding.
overlap_classes.shared_custody_overlap: Two estates are explicitly mapped to the same case, research track, estate slice, or other canonical custody object.
overlap_classes.shared_source_infrastructure: Two estates use the same canonical source family. This is operational infrastructure only and creates no subject relationship.
overlap_classes.bounded_non_overlap: No second estate was reached on the declared trail surface. This is not evidence that no real-world relationship exists.
overlap_classes.unresolved_boundary: The trail cannot be typed or resolved without a source, identity, jurisdiction, or temporal upgrade.

required_outputs: origin estate and source trail identifier
typed path with node and edge kinds
first overlap class or bounded terminal state

legacy_states.origin_custody: The trail originates in this estate custody.
legacy_states.exact_identifier_overlap: The same typed identifier is explicit in the trail and target estate corpus.
legacy_states.declared_domain_overlap: The explicit record type is within the target estate scope and source plan; this is routing, not a subject relationship.
legacy_states.shared_source_only: The trail and estate share canonical acquisition infrastructure without a typed subject or instrument overlap.
legacy_states.bounded_non_overlap: A bounded searched denominator or complete named surface returned no match under the declared identifiers and window.
legacy_states.frontier_unresolved: Identity, denominator, source access, jurisdiction, or temporal order is insufficient to decide overlap or non-overlap.
legacy_states.out_of_estate_scope: The trail terminates on a private or author-controlled surface outside the public estate system.
legacy_states.not_reached_under_declared_predicate: No authored predicate routes this trail to the estate; this is not a negative result.
